text:
**Best all-around: Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 with two 200 W solar panels.** It pairs a near-2 kWh battery (2,042 Wh) with 2,200 W output and 400 W of included panels—a more substantial solar bundle than a single-panel kit. [Generator & Backup’s comparison](https://generatorandbackup.com/power-stations/best-solar-generators-home-backup) names it the most complete kit.

If you want a setup you can **expand later**, consider the **EcoFlow DELTA 2 Max with two 220 W panels**: it accepts up to 1,000 W of solar and can expand to 6 kWh. [The same comparison](https://generatorandbackup.com/power-stations/best-solar-generators-home-backup) favors it for expandability.

For a lower-priced option, the **BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W kit** is listed at $1,199, but a single 200 W panel may take 2–3 sunny days to refill the battery. [Dealectric’s listing](https://dealectric.com/best-2000wh-solar-generator-kit-with-panels) has the kit details and buy link. Actual solar charging time varies with sun and conditions.

judge.top_pick: Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 + 2× 200 W solar panels
